capabilities: Share the open note, cursor and selection with the pi agent
Inject formatted editor context into every pi prompt automatically
Manage per-project rules files that exclude files from context injection
Show connected editor and selection status in pi's status line or Starline pill
extras: Exclusion rules are defaults, not a security boundary; agents can still read excluded files. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Companion clients exist for Neovim, VS Code and JetBrains IDEs; full protocol documented in docs/protocol.md.
intentEvidence: like Claude Code's IDE integration, but for Neovim, VS Code, Obsidian and JetBrains IDEs
problem: Using pi on vault notes means manually copying file paths, cursor positions and selected text into prompts, because the agent has no view of what you are looking at.

relations.evidence: /ide for pi — like Claude Code's IDE integration, but for Neovim, VS Code, Obsidian and JetBrains IDEs.
